Package index

Decide and plan

Sample sizes and power for a Solomon study, before data are collected, and simulated studies with known effects for teaching and for checking an analysis plan.

plan_solomon() stable
Sample-size planning for Solomon designs
power_solomon() stable
Power simulation for Solomon designs
plot_power_solomon() stable
Power curves for a Solomon design
analysis_plan_solomon() experimental
Write an analysis plan for a Solomon four-group study
simulate_solomon() stable
Simulate a Solomon four-group study with known effects

Check the design

Design coding, cell structure, clustering, missingness, and baseline balance, before analysis.

validate_solomon() stable
Validate the structure and coding of a Solomon design
check_solomon_missing() stable
Distinguish structural and incidental missingness in a Solomon design
check_solomon_assumptions() stable
Descriptive assumption diagnostics for Solomon analyses
baseline_solomon() stable
Baseline comparison of the pretested arms

Analyze: recommended methods

One model for all the groups, with robust, likelihood-based, and randomization-based inference. fit_solomon_glm() also analyzes designs with several treatments.

fit_solomon_glm() stable
Fit the unified GLM for a Solomon Four-Group design
fit_solomon_ml() stable
Full-information ML analysis for a Solomon Four-Group Design
marginal_solomon() stable
Marginal Solomon contrasts for binary and count outcomes
perm_solomon() stable
Permutation test for a Solomon contrast
equivalence_solomon() stable
Equivalence test for a Solomon contrast
compare_solomon_methods() stable
Compare Solomon analyses and their estimands

Analyze: missing posttests

Multiple imputation of missing posttests under missing at random, with delta-adjusted sensitivity analyses and a tipping-point summary.

fit_solomon_mi() experimental
Solomon analysis with multiply imputed posttests
tipping_point_solomon() experimental
Tipping-point analysis for missing posttests

Analyze: longitudinal designs

Several posttest occasions, analyzed with a mixed model for repeated measures that is valid when participants drop out at random.

fit_solomon_mmrm() experimental
Mixed model for repeated measures in a longitudinal Solomon design

Analyze: latent variables

Observed- and latent-variable structural equation models, and measurement invariance across the Solomon groups.

fit_solomon_sem() experimental
SEM analysis for Solomon Four-Group designs (mean-structure; optional ANCOVA)
fit_solomon_sem_latent() experimental
Latent SEM for Solomon Four-Group designs (POST means; optional latent ANCOVA)
invariance_solomon() experimental
Measurement invariance across the four Solomon groups

Report

APA 7 results text with the references for the methods used.

report_solomon() stable
APA 7 results text for a Solomon analysis

Synthesize

Reanalyze published studies from summary statistics and compute effect sizes for meta-analysis.

solomon_from_summary() stable
Solomon analysis from summary statistics
solomon_effect_sizes() stable
Solomon effect sizes for meta-analysis

History: historical procedures

Procedures retained for teaching and for reproducing historical analyses, labeled by author and year. They are not the recommended analyses.

fit_solomon_1949() stable
Solomon's (1949) improvement-score analysis
fit_solomon_classic() stable
Historical Solomon Four-Group Analysis
plot_classic_flow() stable
Historical Solomon decision path
fit_solomon_steyn() stable
Steyn's (2009) analysis of the extended Solomon design
fisher_solomon() stable
Historical categorical analysis of a binary Solomon outcome
stouffer_solomon() stable
Stouffer's Z combiner (Walton Braver & Braver, 1988, Test I)
p_to_z() stable
Convert p-value to Z (one-tailed) for Stouffer's method

Plotting

plot_solomon_means() stable
Plot Solomon posttest cell means
plot_tipping_point() experimental
Plot a tipping-point analysis
plot_perm() stable
Plot permutation distribution for a Solomon contrast
plot_solomon_effects() stable
Forest plot of the Solomon contrasts
plot_sensitization() stable
Pretest sensitization figure
plot_solomon_design() stable
Schematic of a Solomon design
plot_solomon_change() stable
Pretest-to-posttest change in a Solomon design

Data

solomon_example
Simulated Solomon four-group study (primary example)
solomon_demo
Demo Solomon four-group data set (second example)
elkarkri2025a
Pretest and posttest statistics from El Karkri et al. (2025a)
jordaan2014
Group statistics from Jordaan's (2014) study with three posttest occasions
kvalem1996
Condom use in the Solomon study of Kvalem et al. (1996)
lana1959
Posttest statistics from Lana's (1959) attitude experiment
mai2020
Transfer-intervention data from Mai et al. (2020)
solomon1949
Solomon's (1949) spelling experiment
steyn2005
Group statistics from Steyn's (2005) eight-group study

Deprecated

Former names that still work, with a warning, through v1.x. Each help page names the replacement.

plot_solomon() deprecated
Plot Solomon posttest cell means in base graphics (deprecated)
plot_solomon_gg() deprecated
Plot Solomon posttest cell means with ggplot2 (deprecated)
